scope: Conversation-first answers, server-bound follow-ups, remembered explicit models, local image notes and native spelling; no new physics.

checks: Centered chat starts invitingly, native spelling is explicit, and Ultra choice survives reload without a request or server-default change
A direct question is followed by its accepted plain-language answer before collapsed evidence, with the canonical result visible and composer cleared
Follow-up is a second explicit turn with a server-validated parent and captured conversation; Shift+Enter adds a line and full historical evidence remains accessible
New/resumed conversations send nothing; image preview and notes survive close, and only explicitly supplied text is sent—no pixels, filename or hidden vision claim
Tavily spelling changes only user text, mobile chat stays contained, and original project/sources/allowance remain unchanged without external traffic
Repeated project names are visibly distinct through stable real identities without renaming, deleting or hiding records
Selected project and saved revision have an addressable overview
Passing calculation criteria remain separate from nine missing fit declarations and one unsupported analysis, with a working coverage action
Opening a report from lower Overview and accepted Back/Forward start at the page heading instead of inheriting a deep scroll
Tool badges distinguish recorded flight, absent mappings and uncalculated staging, and update across projects and historical revisions
The actual assistant picker distinguishes battery and engine temperature checks while retaining their exact requirement IDs without inference
Overview uses compact shared precision while a selected finding exposes exact values and preserves its canonical status
Authoring groups retain every input source and record action, and project export preserves original names, SI unit strings and full numeric values
Draft edits keep their grouped section open without saving, and readable native unit labels retain canonical selection values
Pages keep one visible primary heading, preserve flight exclusions and exact diagnostics, and expand then restore folded project scope for printing
Five broad work areas are reachable without a flat list of every tool
Native browser Back and Forward restore internal locations
Reload preserves the routed project, saved revision and work area
A deep link to a historical revision survives reload
System Table, selected requirement and evidence panel survive deep reload with a parent breadcrumb
Same-project page navigation and Back retain the unsaved shared draft without a database write
Cancelled project switch preserves draft; confirmed switch explicitly discards it
Cancelling browser Back across project context preserves URL, displayed project and draft
Accepting browser Back loads the previous saved project and discards only the unsaved draft
Back during a delayed project load leaves URL and displayed project in the same context
Unapplied stage-profile values survive blocked area, project and revision navigation
Browser Back cannot remount or discard an unapplied stage-profile form
Explicit profile cancellation restores navigation while saved staged inputs stay unchanged
Actual locally loaded Geist Sans/Mono, readable sizes, ink and soft canvas cover the workspace with no external font request
Sidebar focus mode gives the main content its width, remembers the preference and leaves route, mounted content and saved evidence unchanged
Mobile sidebar has an explicit open/close control and independent preference without route changes or horizontal overflow
Original fixture receipts unchanged; no provider, search, upload, calculation or save POSTs; no browser errors
Guided review opens and closes in place from Projects, work-area hubs, Overview and Systems without hidden navigation or provider calls
Calculate and Recalculate each save a new review on an already calculated revision, show progress/completion and prevent duplicate in-flight starts
The companion draws actual local WebGL geometry rather than the previous SVG, with frames rendered before interaction
Pointer dragging repositions without opening AI, restores its saved preference after reload, and retains click/keyboard movement while resting clear of page controls
Reduced motion pauses the rocket animation without removing its functional launcher
Nemotron keeps the primary question/model/start controls and all three models, makes no selection-triggered call, and preserves a completed evidence-backed answer
Tavily starts with a small duplicate-free human-readable list, while Advanced preserves exact finding/assumption targets without starting a search
Copying a preview to the same Source library refuses a nonempty editor, preserves its exact draft and mounted DOM, retains the preview and makes no extra search/save/link/model call
The Source library shows Copied draft, Saved source version and Linked progress, and saves/links only through two separate explicit actions with the exact source version
Ask about this reference opens the same rocket with its exact saved project/revision/calculation/check and source identity, without starting inference or repeating search/save/link
Project names, source text, native controls and Nemotron dialog copy share the global UI font rather than local module-specific stacks
Dragged companion and simplified conversation remain inside a narrow mobile viewport with no page-wide horizontal overflow
Simplified hosted conversation preserves the existing owner-only controls and financial-status boundary
Only explicit isolated actions posted; original design, numerical results and allowance remain unchanged, with no external provider traffic
Graphics-context loss exposes the honest local fallback while the draggable assistant remains functional
System launcher opens the exact selected check with project, saved revision, current page and finding context visible
Explicit scope and check changes retain the typed question, and same-page reopen retains the explicit scope
Changing the selected system item resets ordinary launcher scope safely instead of submitting a visually unselected null check
Overview and report launcher defaults reset to whole project, preserve the typed question, and show the current page
Visible references use the exact selected check/model scope and separate current links from unresolved links
Existing hidden exact-row handoff opens its own requirement from prior project scope; another check parks the row and returning restores it
No context choice triggers a provider request; one explicit synthetic Ask sends exactly the selected requirement and test row
Project and historical-revision changes do not attach another context’s question or row; historical answers stay scoped and reference search is blocked
An open draft describes the saved baseline and blocks Ask and reference search until saved or discarded
Saved designs, reference snapshots, historical receipts and allowance ceiling remain unchanged; no external requests or browser errors occur
